name: Quest Tracker
author: Randommagic
description: Shows the items needed for faction missions and seed research, below the game's built-in quest display. Requires DTMAPI.

localized_description.english: Shows the items needed for faction missions and seed research, below the game's built-in quest display. Requires DTMAPI.
localized_description.schinese: 在游戏画面自带的任务提示下方，显示势力任务和种子研究所需的道具。需要 DTMAPI。
